SprintZero Studio
A one-operator software studio that ships deployed MVPs in 72-hour sprints. Fixed scope, fixed price from $1,500, and the client owns the repo, keys, and brand kit.
SprintZero Studio is run by a single operator. Every sprint starts with the studio's own pipeline (Murmur), which turns an idea into a product foundation (PRD, architecture, brand, task board) in under ten minutes. The rest of the 72 hours is human-led build work.
How a sprint works

* Day 0 (0–24h): discovery call, idea to foundation via the pipeline, scope locked, clock starts.
* Day 1–2 (24–72h): architecture, brand, UI, and a real build with a daily build link.
* Day 3 (72h): deployed to production, repo and keys transferred, walkthrough recording.
* 30 days of post-launch support (bug fixes and questions on what shipped) is included.
